overall.summary: The tool description omits critical security behaviors including robots.txt enforcement, private IP blocking, and potential Node.js process spawning. The implementation includes extensive network security controls and content processing that are not disclosed to users.

startup.behaviour: Modifies process environment variables (HTTP_PROXY, http_proxy, HTTPS_PROXY, https_proxy, ALL_PROXY, all_proxy) by normalizing socks:// URLs to socks5://
